test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 26 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What is the total surface area of a cone whose curved surface area is 550 cm² and radius is 7 cm ? ( Take π = 22/7).
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The Total Surface Area (TSA) of a cone is directly the sum of its Curved Surface Area (CSA) and its Base Area.

Base Area = π × r² = (22/7) × 7 × 7 = 154 cm²

TSA = CSA + Base Area = 550 + 154 = 704 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 704.00 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/450038cf22a35c120dbadf332a5029c557986bf74e7bd175cea2516fa888296b.png] 

**Given:**

Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 550 cm²

Radius of the base (r) = 7 cm

**Formula Used:**

CSA of a cone = πrl (where l is the slant height)

Total Surface Area (TSA) = πr(l + r)

**Calculations:**

⇒ π × r × l = 550

⇒ (22/7) × 7 × l = 550

⇒ 22 × l = 550

⇒ l = 550 ÷ 22 = 25 cm

⇒ TSA = π × r × (l + r)

⇒ TSA = (22/7) × 7 × (25 + 7)

⇒ TSA = 22 × 32

⇒ TSA = 704 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 704.00 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Cone

The volume of a cone is one-third the volume of a cylinder with the same base radius and height. Formula: V = (1/3)πr²h

Slant Height Relationship

The slant height (l), radius (r), and perpendicular height (h) form a right-angled triangle. By Pythagoras theorem: l² = r² + h²

Surface Area Comparison

Curved Surface Area is just the lateral conical covering (πrl). Total Surface Area includes both this lateral cover and the flat circular bottom base (πr²).
